name: substrate
reason: Nothing in either repo operationalises a substrate factor. The corpus lists tools that touch memory and timing indirectly, but no entry states a procedure plus an oracle for any of these 62. This is the largest single gap in the project and it is stated rather than hidden.

L01-010.note: inspect_wasm_artifact validates a module and reports sections, imports and exports. That examines module structure, not how the engine compiles it, so it is a name in the area and not a procedure for the factor.

L01-044.note: jwt_tool tests signature and claim handling, which includes whether a token can be forged without the key. That touches entropy failure as a symptom, not the source of entropy itself.

L01-062.note: The core rule set is the artefact that a mitigation completeness question would be tested against. It names the area and gives no procedure for finding a bypass of a mitigated path.
